name: USDC Payments with Buyer Protection
author: instantescrow

sections.description:
USDC Payments with Buyer Protection is a WooCommerce payment gateway that enables your store to accept USDC (USD Coin) cryptocurrency payments with built-in buyer protection through smart contract escrow technology.

Service Availability: When Conduit UCPI services are unavailable, the plugin provides fallback instructions for manual USDC payments directly to your wallet address.

Key Features

  • USDC Payments: Accept USDC cryptocurrency on the Base blockchain network
  • Buyer Protection: Smart contract escrow ensures funds are held safely until order completion
  • Dispute Resolution: Built-in dispute system for handling payment issues
  • Seamless Integration: Works with existing WooCommerce checkout flow
  • Mobile-Friendly: Responsive payment interface works on all devices
  • Real-time Updates: Automatic order status updates via webhooks
  • Admin Dashboard: Complete visibility into payment contracts and statuses

How It Works

  1. Customer Checkout: Customer selects USDC payment method at checkout
  2. Escrow Creation: Smart contract creates secure escrow holding customer funds
  3. Order Fulfillment: Merchant ships order and provides tracking
  4. Payment Release: Funds are delivered to seller at payout date and time unless dispute is raised
  5. Dispute Protection: If issues arise, buyer can raise a dispute, which freezes funds until a resolution is agreed, built-in dispute resolution protects both parties

Benefits for Merchants

  • Lower Fees: Significantly lower transaction fees compared to traditional payment processors (1% with 30c minimum)
  • No Chargebacks: Crypto payments are final, eliminating chargeback fraud, disputes management system handles refunds.
  • Global Reach: Accept payments from customers worldwide without currency conversion
  • Fast Settlement: Funds available immediately upon contract completion
  • Buyer Confidence: Escrow protection increases customer trust and conversion rates

Benefits for Customers

  • Purchase Protection: Funds held safely in escrow until payout date&time (you should set this to be after delivery)
  • Dispute Resolution: Fair process for resolving issues with orders – automated disputes management system facilitates negotiation on refund %
  • Privacy: No need to share credit card, banking information or even email address
  • Lower Costs: Save on international transaction fees
  • Modern Payment: Use cutting-edge blockchain technology for secure payments

Technical Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or higher
  • WooCommerce 5.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • SSL certificate (HTTPS required)
  • Base network wallet address for receiving payments

Supported Networks

  • Base Mainnet: Production payments (Chain ID: 8453)
  • Base Sepolia Testnet: Testing and development (Chain ID: 84532)

Integration

This plugin integrates with the Conduit UCPI infrastructure:

  • Frontend Interface: Modern React-based payment interface
  • Smart Contracts: Audited escrow contracts on Base blockchain
  • Backend API: Reliable payment processing and status updates
  • Webhook System: Real-time order status synchronization

Support

For technical support and questions:

  • Documentation: Visit docs.conduit-ucpi.com
  • Support Forum: Use the WordPress.org support forum for this plugin
  • Email Support: Contact support@conduit-ucpi.com for enterprise customers
  • GitHub: Report issues at github.com/conduit-ucpi/wordpress-plugin

Privacy Policy

EXTERNAL SERVICE INTEGRATION: This plugin sends data to external Conduit UCPI services to process payments.

Data Sent to External Services:
* Customer email address (for payment notifications)
* Order amount and description
* Merchant wallet address
* Transaction details and timestamps

Where Data Goes:
* Conduit UCPI Servers: Payment processing and contract management – we store the email address of the merchant and the buyer (if provided) and the transaction details.
* Base Blockchain: All transactions are publicly recorded on blockchain – no personally identifiable information is sent to the blockchain
* Your Wallet: USDC payments are sent directly to your configured wallet address at the payout date & time.

Data Retention:
* Transaction data retained for dispute resolution and compliance requirements
* Blockchain records are permanent and publicly visible
* No credit card or banking information is collected or stored

Third Party Services:
* Conduit UCPI Frontend: Privacy Policy
* Base Network: Public blockchain network

sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to your WordPress admin dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins → Add New
  3. Search for “USDC Payments with Buyer Protection”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  3. Choose the ZIP file and click “Install Now”
  4. Activate the plugin

Configuration

  1. Enable the Gateway:

    • Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Payments
    • Find “USDC with Buyer Protection” and click “Set up”
    • Check “Enable USDC Payments”

  2. Configure Settings:

    • Merchant Wallet: If you don’t already have a Base wallet address to receive funds, go to https://app.instantescrow.nz and go through authentication once, (it takes 30s and all you need is an email address); then navigate to the wallet management screen to grab your wallet address.
    • Merchant Wallet Address: Enter your Base network wallet address
    • Frontend URL: Use default (https://app.instantescrow.nz) or enter custom Conduit UCPI frontend URL
    • Test Mode: Enable for testing with Base Sepolia testnet
    • Contract Timeout: Set escrow timeout period (default: 72 hours)

  3. Set Up Webhooks:

    • Copy the webhook URL from the settings page
    • Contact Conduit UCPI support to configure webhooks for your merchant wallet

  4. Test the Integration:

    • Create a test order for a tiny amount (min 30c)
    • Complete payment flow to verify everything works
sections.faq:
What is USDC?

USDC (USD Coin) is a stablecoin cryptocurrency pegged to the US Dollar. Each USDC token is backed by one US dollar, making it a stable and reliable form of digital currency.

What is escrow protection?

Escrow protection means customer funds are held in a smart contract until the payout date&time. You should set a sensible default for this (eg 14 days), and it is configurable per delivery type. This protects buyers from fraud while ensuring sellers get paid for legitimate transactions.

What happens if there’s a dispute?

If a customer raises a dispute, the funds remain in escrow while the issue is resolved. Conduit UCPI provides dispute resolution services to fairly handle conflicts between buyers and sellers. Both buyer and seller can send messages and suggested refund amounts through the dispute manager. When both agree on refund % (0-100), the funds are distributed accordingly. If no agreement can be reached, or one party is unresponsive for more than a week, escalation to the admin team is recommended (via email: disputes@conduit-ucpi.com)

What fees are charged?

The plugin itself is free. When a buyer makes a payment, the plugin automatically takes a 1% fee (minimum 30c), which covers all costs, including blockchain transaction/gas fees. This is typically much lower than traditional payment processor fees.

Can I use this with any WooCommerce store?

Yes, the plugin works with any WooCommerce store. You just need a Base network wallet address to receive payments.

What if a customer doesn’t confirm receipt?

Escrow contracts have a timeout period (default 72 hours). If the customer doesn’t confirm receipt within this time, the merchant can claim the funds.

Is this secure?

Yes, the system uses audited smart contracts on the Base blockchain. Customer funds are protected by cryptographic security, and all transactions are transparent and verifiable.

Do I need to handle cryptocurrency myself?

No, the plugin handles all the technical aspects. You just need a wallet address to receive payments. The Conduit UCPI infrastructure manages everything else and gives you a wallet management tool so that you can move your earnings to other wallets, or exchanges for converting to FIAT.

Can customers pay without a cryptocurrency wallet?

Customers need a Web3 wallet (like MetaMask) or can use an email address or social login, which will automatically creat them a wallet instantly. The payment interface guides them through the process.

What countries is this available in?

The service is available globally, wherever cryptocurrency is legal. There are no geographic restrictions on the technology itself.

What happens if the payment service is down?

The plugin includes automatic fallback functionality. If Conduit UCPI services are unavailable, customers will see instructions to send USDC directly to your wallet address and email you the transaction hash for manual verification.
